description: This file defines a subagent run manager for handling subagent lifecycle events, including registration, termination, restart, cleanup, and communication with external systems via gateway and logging. It manages subagent run records, handles cleanup, and coordinates asynchronous operations related to subagent execution.

methods.name: shouldDeleteAttachments
methods.description: Determines if attachments should be deleted based on the run record's cleanup and retainAttachmentsOnKeep properties.

methods.name: waitForSubagentCompletion
methods.description: Asynchronously waits for a subagent run to complete, updates its record, and triggers cleanup and completion procedures.

methods.name: markSubagentRunForSteerRestart
methods.description: Marks a subagent run for restart by setting its suppressAnnounceReason to 'steer-restart'.

methods.name: clearSubagentRunSteerRestart
methods.description: Clears the steer restart mark from a subagent run and resumes it if it has already finished.

methods.name: replaceSubagentRunAfterSteer
methods.description: Replaces an existing subagent run with a new one after a steer operation, preserving certain properties and scheduling completion.

methods.name: registerSubagentRun
methods.description: Registers a new subagent run, creates associated background task, and initiates wait for its completion.

methods.name: releaseSubagentRun
methods.description: Releases a subagent run, removes it from tracking, and notifies external systems.

methods.name: markSubagentRunTerminated
methods.description: Marks one or more subagent runs as terminated with an error reason, updates records, persists timing, and triggers cleanup and hooks.
